name: io.github.kinkirill/bevy-mcp
title: Bevy MCP
description: Version-accurate Bevy API docs, Book, migration guides and examples for AI agents.

environmentVariables.name: BEVY_PROJECT_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Path to the Cargo project used to detect the Bevy version.

environmentVariables.name: BEVY_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: Explicit Bevy version override, e.g. 0.20.0 (otherwise read from Cargo.lock).

environmentVariables.name: BEVY_DOC_DIR
environmentVariables.description: cargo target/doc directory, or a fetch-docs.mjs mirror.

environmentVariables.name: BEVY_MCP_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where the persistent search index is stored.

environmentVariables.name: BEVY_MCP_OFFLINE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to disable the crates.io update check.
